title: FOKUS – Continuing Education Program for Primary Care Specialty Practices as part of the INCAP Research Project (Integrated Multiprofessional Primary Care for Severely Affected Patients with Post-Infection Syndrome)
summary: The FOKUS study – Continuing Education Program for Primary Care Specialty Practices as part of the INCAP Research Project (Integrated Multiprofessional Primary Care for Severely Affected Patients with Post-Infection Syndrome) – is funded by the German Federal Ministry of Health (Funding Code: 2524FSB50D). The overarching aim of the project is to improve the care of moderately to severely affected patients with post-acute infection syndromes through the establishment of primary care specialized practices in Baden-Württemberg, complemented by case and care management. The objective of FOKUS is to develop an education program for the participating primary care specialized practices. In this process, it builds upon the training curriculum developed in the preceding SEVEN-PCS project, as well as the experiences gained from the subsequently implemented training program (DRKS00032630).

interventions.name: Individual telephone interviews will be conducted with general practitioners and patients to explore their perspectives, needs, attitudes, and perceptions regarding a continuing education program for primary care specialty practices (SPVP). criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Inclusion Criteria for Patients:
-Adults (≥18 years) with post-COVID syndrome or another post-acute infection syndrome (e.g., following Epstein–Barr virus infection)
-good knowledge of German

Inclusion Criteria for General Practitioners:
-Minimum age of 18 years
-good knowledge of German
-statutory health insurance license as a general practitioner in Baden-Württemberg
-Interest in post-acute infection syndromes

Inclusion Criteria for Project Team Members:
-minimum age of 18 years
-good knowledge of German
-member of the INCAP project team
Exclusion criteria:
Exclusion Criteria for Patients:
-Age <18 years
-Individuals with functional impairments so severe that participation is deemed unfeasible
-non-sufficient knowledge of the German language
-lack of capacity to provide informed consent

Exclusion Criteria for General Practitioners:
-Age <18 years
-non-sufficient knowledge of the German language
-no statutory health insurance license as a general practitioner in Baden-Württemberg

Exclusion Criteria for Project Team Members:
-age <18 years
-non-sufficient knowledge of the German language
